unit_id: optional; generated from row order within (student_id, week) if left empty. Normally produced by scripts/01_prepare_units.R, which builds it from the week and question so the id is readable
student_id: REQUIRED pseudonymous id, never a name (e.g. 99)
week: REQUIRED integer week (1, 4, 7, 10) - the time dimension
text: REQUIRED the text that gets exactly one primary code. Since codebook v5 this is ONE SENTENCE
question: optional; the journal question this sentence answers. Needed only for context_mode = unit_question or unit_question_context
question_no: optional; that question's position within the week
context: optional; the parent paragraph, shown for orientation but NOT coded. Needed for context_mode = unit_context or unit_question_context - which is the default, so normally fill this in
para_id: optional; groups the sentences that came from one paragraph, for aggregating back up to paragraph level
sent_in_para: optional; this sentence's position inside its paragraph
n_sent_in_para: optional; how many sentences that paragraph has
